info.name: Collabspace API
info.description: Run order: 1) Register  2) Register helper: second user  3) List teams  4) Create project  5) Add member  6) Create task, then the rest (comments, files).

request.description: Creates a user with a fresh random email and stores the token in {{token}}.
Creates another user to use as a project member. Does NOT change {{token}}.
Always 200. The link arrives in Mailpit (http://localhost:8025).
Email is read-only in v1. availability_status: available | busy | away.
jpg, jpeg, png or webp, max 2 MB.
After running this, update the {{password}} collection variable to NewSecret123.
Excludes yourself. Matches name (contains) or exact email.
You become the leader. Optional: members[] with user_id, team_id, job_title, role.
PUT replaces: name, priority, status, start_date and end_date are required.
Teams with members and tasks_done / tasks_total per member. Members without a team are in the 'Unassigned' group.
Run 'Register helper: second user' first. 422 if already a member.
The last leader cannot be demoted (422).
Any project member can create. status may be todo | in_progress | in_review (never completed).
Run 'Add member (leader)' first: assignees and the reviewer must be project members (422 otherwise).
Leader, creator or assignee. Never changes status or progress. Send assignee_ids[] to replace assignees.
progress applies only when the new status is in_progress.
Needs the reviewer if one is set (a leader can always). Completion forces progress = 100.
Leader or the task creator.
Max 10 MB. pdf, doc, docx, xls, xlsx, ppt, pptx, png, jpg, jpeg, webp, txt, csv, md, json, sql, zip. task_id (optional) must belong to the same project.
Use 'Send and Download' in Postman. Members only; always served as an attachment.
